SQL_DOC.P_SQL: INSERT INTO ERPDB.KEPRE ( PLANT, RENO, RESEQ, RSTG, RSTGNM, STATUS, ADDDTE, RDDATE, ITEMNO, ITEMDE, ITEMSP, UNIT, MAKER, SPRICE, TPRICE, PURID, REQNME, REQDPT, REQTEL, ITMQTY, REMARK, IFDATE, IFTIME, IFFLAG, IFDECIS ) ( SELECT PLANT, RENO, RESEQ, CAST($AGENT_CODE$ AS CHARACTER(10)), CAST($AGENT_NAME$ AS CHARACTER(50) CCSID 933), CAST($STATUS$ AS CHARACTER(1)), ADDDTE, RDDATE, ITEMNO, ITEMDE, ITEMSP, UNIT, MAKER, SPRICE, CAST($T_PRICE$ AS DECIMAL(17,5)), PURID, REQNME, REQDPT, REQTEL, ITMQTY, REMARK, CAST($IFDATE$ AS CHARACTER(8)), CAST($IFTIME$ AS CHARACTER(6)), '3', CAST($IFDECIS$ AS CHARACTER(1)) FROM ERPDB.KEPRE WHERE PLANT = CAST($PLANT$ AS CHARACTER(10)) AND RENO = CAST($RE_NO$ AS CHARACTER(20)) AND RESEQ = CAST($RE_SEQ$ AS CHARACTER(10)) AND RSTG = '3494' AND IFFLAG IN ('1','3') )
